transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I was thinking about that trip back in 2025 when I went from Beijing to Shanghai—everything felt like a blur.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Shanghai was fun though—after landing I remember we kept joking about how many places there are to eat in Shanghai.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker handled the flight booking, so I didn’t do anything myself—she said it was Air China and the flight was CA1234.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And yeah, it was for 2025-03-21, ticket under Li Na—still can’t believe how last-minute it all felt.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Dinner-wise, we’d already reserved Xiao Nan Guo for a group thing—pretty sure it was set for 2025-03-13 at 19:00.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It ended up being 6 of us, and the booking was under Zhou Jun—his phone was 13877949128, since he was the contact person.
